prerequisites: Fundamental programming concepts, data structures and algorithms
Basic data management and database concepts

learning_outcomes.text: Introduction to AI and Business Intelligence (BI) analysis research and practice.

Ability to plan a data analytics campaign on an unknown analytical problem and an unknown domain, starting from generalizable tools and being able to obtain valid starting baselines that the student will learn how to evaluate appropriately.
Develop communication skills and transversal competencies (collaboration, cooperation, organization) through verbal presentation of the course project.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course and objectives
Overview of AI and Data Mining research design
Planning and execution of an analysis campaign
Practical experience with planning and executing an analysis project
Importance of data quality in analysis
Best practices for ensuring high-quality data
Practical exercises to apply data quality techniques
Principles of design for effective data analysis systems
Design patterns and Data Mesh concepts
Practical application of data design and reporting
Shallow machine learning models and their application in real-world scenarios
Errors and assumptions in machine learning
assessment_rules: The project work is assessed in terms of correctness, completeness, and compatibility of the work with the subject matter. The final grade is based on the project work and its verbal and written reporting.
bibliography: "Fundamentals of Business Intelligence" grossmann w.; rinderle-ma s. 2015
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica (Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
